text.en: if London loses 93.16 with a close, the 4-day bearish restart reactivates with force; if instead it reclaims 94.83, yesterday's bullish flip is fully confirmed

NQ.es: reinicio bajista dia 2: hoy peleo con un rebote real (CHoCH al alza, sesgo fusionado a LONG FUERTE) pero sin romper la invalidacion 30826.75. Londres decide en el cluster POC/EMA 30427-30458 o VAH/DO 30529-30568.
NQ.en: bearish restart day 2: today fought off a real bounce (upside CHoCH, fused bias to LONG STRONG) but never broke the 30826.75 invalidation. London decides at the POC/EMA cluster 30427-30458 or the VAH/DO cluster 30529-30568.

ES.es: tesis alcista de 1 dia sigue viva mas fragil: hoy peleo entre dos clusters casi pegados al precio (7728-7735 y 7740-7753). El cierre que gane decide si la fragilidad de ayer se confirma o si el giro corto de hoy se cae.
ES.en: the 1-day bullish thesis is alive but more fragile: today fought between two clusters almost glued to price (7728-7735 and 7740-7753). Whichever close wins decides if yesterday's fragility is confirmed or today's short flip falls apart.

GC.es: el rebote de gestion esperado (4154-4164) se paso de largo: hoy acepto sobre el rango con CHoCH+ al alza y toco 4179.5, estiramiento extremo (3.2 ATR). AVOID mientras no se resuelva 4181.2 con cierre.
GC.en: the expected management bounce (4154-4164) was blown past: today accepted higher with an upside CHoCH+ and tagged 4179.5, extreme stretch (3.2 ATR). AVOID until 4181.2 resolves with a close.

YM.es: la tesis alcista de 4 dias sobrevivio otro susto serio: hoy barrio 51644 (bajo ambos niveles de invalidacion) y reclamo con fuerza a 51791. La zona 51807-51868 a 16pts decide si el corto del dia aguanta o si el reclamo se confirma.
YM.en: the 4-day bullish thesis survived another serious scare: today it swept 51644 (below both invalidation levels) and reclaimed hard to 51791. The zone at 51807-51868, 16pts away, decides whether the day's short holds or the reclaim gets confirmed.

CL.es: 4a bisagra sin resolver: hoy perforo 93.16 (minimo 93.00) y reclamo con fuerza a 93.85, la reaccion mas alcista medida hasta ahora, pero sigue sin confirmar. Sin catalizador propio hasta el EIA del miercoles.
CL.en: the 4th unresolved hinge: today it pierced 93.16 (low 93.00) and reclaimed hard to 93.85, the most bullish reaction measured so far, but it's still unconfirmed. No catalyst of its own until Wednesday's EIA.
